FormatText.PlainText: Effectiveness trend — resolution rate ▲ vs gap rate ▼
Both are boolean rates per month — deterministic, no text matching. Rising resolution with falling gaps = agent becoming self-sufficient.
ACTIVE = Agent Spaces found · NO_AGENT_SPACES = collector idle · ERROR = last run failed · STALE = no run for more than 5 days
Time to RCA by workload — p50 vs p90
A wide p50→p90 spread means a workload has hard cases the agent struggles with.
Time to RCA month over month — avg vs p90
Is the agent getting faster? Watch the gap between avg and p90.
Where does the agent fail to reach a root cause?
% of investigations that hit ≥1 gap — a boolean count, not string matching
Gap texts by workload — what to fix
Agent-reported gaps (AI wording varies, so these are read as themes, not counted)
Resource hotspots — recurring resources within each workload
Resources as labelled by the agent (roles like “Workload Table”, not ARNs) — meaningful only within a workload, so grouped that way.
Same agent-labelled resources, grouped by AWS account — for account-level follow-up.
